prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a square reaction image of a chubby golden-yellow cartoon giraffe caught at the peak of a belly laugh. Its round belly fills the bottom of the frame. A long, plump neck curves back, tipping its oversized head up in a slight three-quarter view. Push the cheeks so high that the eyes squeeze into two tiny black crescents. Stretch the broad, soft muzzle into an enormous open grin, with the corners curling up around a dark red mouth and a plump pink tongue. Its chin bunches into a fold and its stubby forelegs curl against its belly as if it can barely catch its breath. Give it two short brown-tipped horns, little ears sticking out sideways, and a few chestnut patches down the neck. Render it like a still from a playful 3D cartoon, with smooth rounded shapes, warm soft lighting, and a simple blurred background. Keep the gleeful, slightly ridiculous face large enough to read at sticker size. No lettering.
